findings.text: blocking: the head tare arm aborts in its fixture with EXIT=134 and no pytest summary, leaving ten listed census failures with no passing or named-owner verdict, so the done_when gate is unmet.

non-blocking: the assertion recomputes the production expression live_core_current_a/live_total_current_a from the same receipt, so a defect in the live-current derivation moves both sides and the check stays green.

non-blocking: the assertion recomputes total - core_current, the exact expression at benchmarks/efit_parity_inductance_partition.py:369, rather than comparing to the independent EXPECTED_OUT_OF_CORE_CURRENT_A it already verifies for the banked row.

non-blocking: asserting reconstructed_core_matches_banked is False pins the live core (234 cells) diverging from the bank (95 cells) as the expected state, so repairing the reconstruction would redden the test.
non-blocking: the bank-agreement guard now runs only when the solved contour is closed, and the only observed state is open, so the invariant it exists to enforce never fires on the live data path.

non-blocking: _support_receipt computes the solved inside mask with its own MplPath call and no longer uses _cell_partition, so the field-instrument and inductance receipts can disagree on support membership and the core-count guard is lost.
